caption: A wok with a scattering of sesame seeds in it is struck once with a ladle, and the seeds jump.

sa.check: A wok with a scattering of sesame seeds in it.
A ladle strikes the wok once.
The strike is a single hit.
The strike comes first and the jump follows.

pc.expect: The seeds are still until the ladle hits the wok.
pc.fail: Seeds hop before the ladle reaches the wok; or jump with the ladle held away; or the ladle lands and the seeds stay still.

pc.expect: The seeds leap at the blow and settle in new places; the wok stays seated, rocking a little at most.
pc.fail: The wok tips over or slides across the stove at the tap; or the seeds settle back into their exact previous arrangement; or the seeds keep hopping unchanged to the end of the clip.

pc.expect: Seeds fall back into the wok or over its rim.
pc.fail: Seeds hang in the air; or float up; or seeds that left the wok come back up into it.

pc.expect: The wok is rigid, the ladle rebounds and the seeds stay separate.
pc.fail: The ladle sinks into the wok; or the wok ripples like cloth; or the seeds merge into a paste.

pc.expect: The seeds keep their number, allowing for some leaving the wok; one wok, one ladle.
pc.fail: Seeds appear from nowhere; or all the seeds vanish at once; or the ladle passes through the wok; or the wok changes shape.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The wok's colour, the stove and the seeds' colour stay the same.
pc.fail: The wok changes colour; or the stove changes; or the seeds change colour.

note: The hand on the ladle is a trigger and is not judged.
